_metadata.description: OCI compute shape availability by region, with AD counts per region
_metadata.source: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure documentation and announcements
notes: Shape availability varies by account, tenancy, and capacity. Always verify via OCI Console or CLI before committing to a design.
GPU and HPC shapes have limited regional availability and may require capacity reservations.
E6 shapes launched March 2025; availability expanding beyond initial US/EU regions.
Use oci compute shape list --region <region> for authoritative per-tenancy availability.
Regions marked 'selective' may have availability but require service limit increases or capacity reservations.

us-ashburn-1.notes: Original OCI region, highest shape breadth

us-chicago-1.notes: 3-AD region; strong GPU and HPC availability

VM.Standard.E4.Flex.description: AMD EPYC 7J13 (Milan), flex vCPU 1-64, memory 1-1024 GB
VM.Standard.E4.Flex.notes: Broadly available in all commercial regions; previous-generation AMD shape

VM.Standard.E5.Flex.description: AMD EPYC 9J14 (Genoa), flex vCPU 1-94, memory 1-1094 GB, base 2.4 GHz / boost 3.7 GHz
VM.Standard.E5.Flex.notes: Available across all major commercial regions; 4th-gen AMD EPYC

VM.Standard.E6.Flex.description: AMD EPYC 9J45 (Turin), flex vCPU 1-126, memory 1-1454 GB, base 2.7 GHz / boost 4.1 GHz; up to 2x per-core perf vs E5
VM.Standard.E6.Flex.notes: Launched March 2025. GA in US East/West/Midwest, EU Frankfurt, UK London. Rolling out globally; check console for current availability in other regions.

VM.Standard.A1.Flex.description: Ampere Altra Q80-30 ARM64, flex vCPU 1-80, memory 1-512 GB, max freq 3.0 GHz. Included in OCI Always Free tier (4 OCPUs / 24 GB).
VM.Standard.A1.Flex.notes: Available broadly across all commercial regions. Capacity constraints common on Always Free tier — paid instances generally available on demand. Good fit for cost-sensitive, cloud-native, and containerized workloads.

VM.Standard3.Flex.description: Intel Xeon Platinum 8358 (Ice Lake), flex OCPU 1-32, memory 1-512 GB
VM.Standard3.Flex.notes: Intel flex shape; widely available. Max OCPU lower than AMD equivalents.

BM.GPU4.8.description: 8x NVIDIA A100 (40 GB) SXM4, AMD EPYC 7542 (Rome), 128 vCPU, 2048 GB RAM, 2x 6.4 TB NVMe
BM.GPU4.8.notes: A100 (40 GB) bare metal. Available in major US and EU regions. Capacity reservation strongly recommended. For 80 GB A100, see BM.GPU.A100.v2.8.

BM.GPU.A10.4.description: 4x NVIDIA A10 (24 GB), 128 vCPU, 1024 GB RAM, 2x 3.84 TB NVMe
BM.GPU.A10.4.notes: A10 is mid-range inference GPU (NVIDIA Ampere). Good fit for LLM inference, video rendering, VDI.

BM.GPU.H100.8.description: 8x NVIDIA H100 (80 GB) SXM5, Intel Sapphire Rapids 8480+ (2x56c), 224 vCPU, 2048 GB RAM, NVLink 4.0
BM.GPU.H100.8.notes: Flagship AI training GPU. H100 initially launched in us-ashburn, us-phoenix; expanded to Chicago and London. Capacity reservation required. eu-frankfurt has H100 but demand is high. Contact Oracle for allocation in APAC regions.

BM.HPC2.36.description: Intel Xeon Gold 6154 (Skylake), 36 cores, 3.0 GHz base / 3.7 GHz turbo, 384 GB RAM, RDMA networking (25 Gbps RoCEv2)
BM.HPC2.36.notes: Legacy HPC bare metal with RDMA. Primarily available in US and EU core regions. For new HPC deployments prefer BM.Optimized3.36 or GPU cluster shapes with RDMA.

availability_legend.GA: Generally Available — shape available in this region by default
availability_legend.selective: Available but may require capacity reservation, service limit increase, or quota request
availability_legend.not-available: Not available or no confirmed public availability as of mid-2025

ad_count_summary.note: The original 4 OCI regions (Ashburn, Phoenix, Frankfurt, London) plus Chicago have 3 ADs. All subsequent commercial regions have 1 AD. High-availability architectures in 1-AD regions should use fault domains for physical isolation.
